title: Ever Works — Agent Manifest (.works/agent.yml)
description: Platform-mappable manifest for a single Agent template. Lives at templates/<slug>/.works/agent.yml. Mirrors the user-settable fields on the platform's Agent entity (packages/agent/src/entities/agent.entity.ts). The SOUL.md alongside this manifest is the personality contract and is NOT validated by this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped only on breaking changes.

slug.description: Unique slug, kebab-case. `starter-*` is reserved for built-in templates shipped from this repo.

name.description: Short display name shown in the wizard chip (e.g. 'PM', 'Coder').

scope.description: Default scope the wizard pre-selects. The user can change it.

summary.description: One-sentence description shown under the template card in the wizard.

capabilities.description: Multi-line description of what the agent does. Mapped to Agent.capabilities.

avatarMode.description: How the platform renders the agent's avatar.

avatarIcon.description: Lucide icon name. Required when avatarMode = ICON. See https://lucide.dev/icons.

aiProviderId.description: Optional preferred provider slug (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai'). Leave empty to use the tenant default.

modelId.description: Optional preferred model id (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6'). Leave empty to use the tenant default.

permissions.description: Capabilities the wizard pre-fills. The tenant admin still has the final say at provision time.

heartbeatCadence.description: Cron expression. `null` (or omitted) means manual / no heartbeat.

idleBehavior.description: What the agent does when no task is queued.

suggestedSkills.description: Slugs of recommended skills the wizard pre-checks. The full skills.yml file alongside this manifest is the authoritative list.

kb.description: Knowledge base bulk-imported into the agent on create.

seedPaths.description: Repo-relative paths (under the template folder) whose contents seed the agent's KB.

citationPolicy.description: How aggressively the agent should ground claims in its KB.

prompts.description: Runtime prompts the platform composes when running this template.

system.description: Template-relative path to the final runtime system prompt.

tasks.description: Quick-Action menu entries surfaced in the chat surface.

soul.description: Template-relative path to the SOUL.md personality contract. Conventionally 'SOUL.md'.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering in the wizard.
